response.changelog:
This is the final LineageOS 23.2 (Android 16) release. Its job is to get your phone ready to move to LineageOS 24.0 (Android 17) from the built-in Updater.

What's new

- Upgrade to 24.0 from the Updater. After installing this build, the Updater follows the 24.0 releases and can install them in place, keeping your data.
- Pepito Tweaks descriptions rewritten in plain language.
- GPU performance floor now really is on by default. Before, it stayed off unless you had touched the toggle.

Moving to 24.0

- Install this update first. The Updater will then say you are up to date until the next 24.0 release is published; the upgrade appears after that.
- Stay on the same flavor: vanilla to vanilla, GApps to GApps.
- Take an EDL backup first if you don't have one.

There will be no further 23.2 releases.

### kernel (msm8937)
- misc: bhy: stop the MCU monitor from racing system suspend

### device/Mi8937
- Mi8937: bhy-wrapper: Q14 quaternion resolution; note the dead hals.conf
- Mi8937: wrap the BHy HAL to fix its advertised range/resolution
- Mi8937: create the BHy calibration dir from a system_ext rc
- Mi8937: point the Updater's "Show changelog" at the pepito changelog

### device/mithorium-common
- XiaomiParts: add emergency-only recovery watchdog (experimental, off)
- mithorium-common: load the BHy HAL through its pepito wrapper
- mithorium-common: drop the BHy calibration mkdir from init.target.rc
- thermal: pepito skin config - SEVERE at 60 C, not the Xiaomi 50 C
- thermal: arm trip_point_0 when a zone has no trip_point_1

### LineageParts
- GoTweaks: add emergency-only recovery toggle (experimental, off)
